report:
Brain, right frontal tumour

Received in formalin are fragments of soft tumour tissue from the frontal lobe, measuring 45 x 35 x 20 mm in aggregate. The cut surface is soft and grey-tan with areas of haemorrhage and yellow necrosis. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(A1-A6) tumour.

Specimen
- Procedure: Craniotomy and excision
- Tumour site: Right frontal lobe
- Specimen integrity: Fragmented, received in pieces

Microscopic findings
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a diffusely infiltrating glial neoplasm composed of cells with
  uniform rounded nuclei and perinuclear haloes set in a delicate branching
  capillary network. The tumour shows rounded nuclei with perinuclear haloes, a
  delicate branching capillary network and microcalcification. Mitoses number
  1 per 10 high-power fields. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are
  positive for GFAP and OLIG2. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately
  4 per cent. On molecular testing, IDH1 R132H is expressed, nuclear ATRX
  expression is intact, p53 shows a wild-type pattern, there is codeletion of 1p
  and 19q, there is no homozygous deletion of CDKN2A/B and a TERT promoter
  mutation is detected (C228T).
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Integrated diagnosis
- Integrated diagnosis: Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted, CNS
  WHO grade 2
- Histopathological classification: Oligodendroglioma
- CNS WHO grade: 2

Molecular information
- IDH1 R132H (immunohistochemistry): Positive
- ATRX (immunohistochemistry): Intact nuclear expression
- p53 (immunohistochemistry): Normal (wild-type pattern)
- 1p/19q (FISH): 1p/19q codeletion detected
- CDKN2A / CDKN2B: No homozygous deletion detected
- TERT promoter: Mutation detected (C228T)

Additional findings
- None identified

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, craniotomy and excision
- OLIGODENDROGLIOMA, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted, CNS WHO grade 2; see
  synoptic report
